title: Follow a named route
summary: Flask: Follow a named route. Inspect the first response Location header.
introduction: url_for builds a URL from a function endpoint name. GET /start redirects a browser to /hello.
learningObjectives: Follow a named route with Flask
Inspect the first response Location header

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Follow a named route

blocks.text: url_for finds the hello endpoint. The redirect tells the browser to request that URL.
Inspect the first response Location header.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The endpoint name here is the Python function name, not the URL text.
